name: Flurbiprofen Sodium
indications_original: Flurbiprofen sodium ophthalmic solution is indicated for the inhibition of intraoperative miosis.
contraindications_original: A total of four (4) drops of flurbiprofen sodium ophthalmic solution should be administered by instilling one (1) drop approximately every 1/2 hour beginning 2 hours before surgery.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Flurbiprofen sodium ophthalmic solution USP, 0.03% is supplied in a plastic bottle with a controlled drop tip in the following size:
                  2.5 mL -  NDC 69292-722-25
                  
                     
                        DO NOT USE IF IMPRINTED “Protective Seal” WITH YELLOW 
                        
                     
                     
                        IS NOT INTACT.
adverseReactions_original: Flurbiprofen sodium ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in individuals who are hypersensitive to any components of the medication.
